Section 29 of the Residential Apartment Buildings (Compliance and Enforcement Powers) Act 2020

Summary of Order

  1. Natoby Pty Ltd (A.C.N 601533519) (the Developer) is issued with this Stop Work Order (Order) in relation to a residential apartment building located at 1170-1176 Botany Road, Botany, NSW 2019 (Lot B DP 176066, Lot 1 DP 907188, Lot 1 DP 656306, Lot 2 Sec1 DP773) (the Development).
  2. The Developer is required to ensure all building work on the Development stop in accordance with the Order, effective from the date of this Order and in accordance with the conditions in this Order.
  3. This Order is subject to the following conditions: 

    Continue with excavation and monitoring to complete bulk excavation and continue through with construction to placement and finishing of the ground floor level structural concrete slab in accordance with the following:
     
    1. The Developer to conduct the works in accordance with the methodologies for execution and monitoring outlined in the EI Consulting Engineers Report dated 26 February 2026 and the email from EI Consulting Engineers dated 2 April 2026. In the event the movement thresholds are reached or exceeded, works are to stop immediately and the Secretary informed at OCaudits@customerservice.nsw.gov.au; and
    2. The Developer to conduct the works whilst monitoring throughout each day the crack gauges installed to the property at 1178 Botany Road, Botany, NSW, 2019. In the event of any movement detected in these crack gauges, works are to stop immediately and the Secretary informed at OCAudits@customerservice.nsw.gov.au
    3. The Developer may have building work carried out to stabilise the Development including the impact on “Impacted Properties”.
